say:1:1012441001:0.text: What did Elona say to you, Bryon? She seems anxious.
say:1:1012441001:0.source_cn: 布莱恩，艾洛娜和你说什么了？它好像很着急。

say:2:1012441002:0.text: We agreed that she should visit Taran Village as we're both concerned about the situation there.
say:2:1012441002:0.source_cn: 我担心塔兰村的情况，派艾洛娜回去了一趟。

say:3:1012441003:0.text: She told me that the corruption of Lovers' Wish has gotten worse due to the influence of the Lucent Tree. This has put Hewynn in a terrible state.
say:3:1012441003:0.source_cn: 它告诉我，受流荧树影响，情人之愿的腐化越来越严重，而伊...

say:4:1012441004:1.text: I'm afraid we'll have to return to Taran Village as soon as possible.
say:4:1012441004:1.source_cn: 恐怕我们得尽快返回塔兰村。

say:5:1012441005:1.text: As much as I worry about Hewynn, we finally have a lead on Eomir.
say:5:1012441005:1.source_cn: 虽然我也很担心伊温，但是，不继续追查伊米尔吗？好不容易...

say:6:1012441006:1.text: Will we ever find him again if he runs away now? He harmed the Dark Forest. He must pay!
say:6:1012441006:1.source_cn: 万一他跑得更远了，下次我们要如何才能找到他？他伤害了薄...

say:7:1012441007:2.text: How about I stay here, Lyca?

say:8:1012441008:1.text: If Eomir is really hiding nearby, I should be able to hear him. Leave this trivial matter to me.
say:8:1012441008:1.source_cn: 如果伊米尔真的躲在附近，我应该能听见他的声音！这种小事...

say:9:1012441009:2.text: Stop messing around! You're no match for him!
say:9:1012441009:2.source_cn: 不许乱来！你不是他的对手，不准擅自行动！

say:11:1012441011:2.text: You don't know what you're talking about! Lorsan always gets in over his head!
say:11:1012441011:2.source_cn: 别添乱！洛桑的水平你还不清楚？

say:12:1012441012:1.text: I know what I'm doing, Lyca. Don't worry about me. If there's danger, I know how to escape.
say:12:1012441012:1.source_cn: 姐，我自有分寸，你别担心我了。遇到危险，我知道该如何逃跑。

choice_prompt:13:1012441012.text: I know what I'm doing, Lyca. Don't worry about me. If there's danger, I know how to escape.
choice_prompt:13:1012441012.source_cn: 姐，我自有分寸，你别担心我了。遇到危险，我知道该如何逃跑。

say:14:1012441013:1.text: That's right. If things get dangerous, I'll just hightail it out of there.
say:14:1012441013:1.source_cn: 对呀，就算打不过，遇到危险，我起码知道该往哪跑啊。

say:15:1012441015:1.text: Lyca, do you recall what you told Eironn? If you can't trust others, how can you ask others to do the same?
say:15:1012441015:1.source_cn: 莱卡，还记得你说给埃隆的话吗？自己都做不到的事，又怎么...

say:16:1012441016:2.source_cn: 我……\n好吧……真是败给你了，布莱恩。

say:17:1012441017:1.text: Lorsan, you must promise me that you will protect yourself.
say:17:1012441017:1.source_cn: 洛桑，你要答应我，必须保护好自己。

say:18:1012441018:1.text: Not a problem! Go ahead, everyone. When you get back, I bet I'll have some wonderful news to share with you.
say:18:1012441018:1.source_cn: 没问题！你们快去快回。等你们回来，我一定会用好消息迎接...

choice:13:0:1.text: Lyca, you need to trust Lorsan.
choice:13:0:1.male: Lyca, you need to trust Lorsan.
choice:13:0:1.female: Lyca, you need to trust Lorsan.

say:20:1012441014:1.text: Yes! I still remember the first time I met Magister Merlin. I was also running away at the time.
say:20:1012441014:1.source_cn: 没错！我还记得第一次遇见梅林大人，就是在逃跑的路上！
say:20:1012441014:1.male: Yes! I still remember the first time I met Magister Merlin. I was also running away at the time.
say:20:1012441014:1.female: Yes! I still remember the first time I met Magister Merlin. I was also running away at the time.

choice:13:1:2.text: Lorsan's got luck on his side.
choice:13:1:2.male: Lorsan's got luck on his side.
choice:13:1:2.female: Lorsan's got luck on his side.
